workItems.title: Integrate pipeline admission and actual host lifetime drain
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: P07: idempotent opt-in factory on one actual provider; close admission and drain after listener before dependent business teardown, native/facade/failure cleanup; preserve Startup independence and existing module shutdown order. Include held-work integration tests and host documentation.
workItems.validation: Actual native web/nonweb facade and failed startup/late Build/canceled host waits with held accepted work. Listener precedes drain, business teardown follows drain; dependencies remain usable through real settlement. Reject unsupported bridge order; Startup coordinator remains independent.
